cat > /workspace/tmp/test_more.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
h=lambda n:'2001:db8:1:1200::%s'%n

# queries processed in increasing order
rows=[icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo')]
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[30,10,20],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
check('queries sorted', [s['at'] for s in out['snapshots']]==[10,20,30], [s['at'] for s in out['snapshots']])

# lease inactive at the first query, active later
rows=[icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
      app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'web',0,'open','')]
job=base_job(leases=[lease(start=50,end=100)],queries=[10,60],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
s10,s60=out['snapshots']
check('inactive first', s10['leases'][0]['state']=='inactive', s10['leases'][0])
check('inactive unbound', s10['unbound_applications']==1, s10)
check('active later', s60['leases'][0]['state']=='usable', s60['leases'][0])
check('active later open', s60['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open']==[h('1')], s60['leases'][0]['services'][0])

# overlapping leases stay separate
l1=lease('a','2001:db8:1:1200::/64')
l2=lease('b','2001:db8:1:1200::/64')
rows=[icmp('r1',1,5,'a',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo')]
job=base_job(leases=[l1,l2],queries=[10],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
leases={l['lease']:l for l in out['snapshots'][0]['leases']}
check('overlap lease a', leases['a']['internal']==[h('1')] and leases['a']['unresolved']==[h('2')], leases['a'])
check('overlap lease b', leases['b']['internal']==[] and leases['b']['unresolved']==[h('1'),h('2')], leases['b'])
check('overlap manifest', len(out['manifest'])==6, len(out['manifest']))
check('overlap probes', out['manifest'][0]['probe']=='0/c' and out['manifest'][3]['probe']=='0/c', out['manifest'])

# /56 lease with several subnets
job=base_job(leases=[lease(prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::/56',subnets=(0,3,17),low=1)],queries=[10])
out,_=run(job)
check('subnet manifest', [m['probe'] for m in out['manifest']]==['0/c','0/i1','3/c','3/i1','17/c','17/i1'],
      [m['probe'] for m in out['manifest']])
check('subnet targets', out['manifest'][2]['target'].startswith('2001:db8:1:1203::'), out['manifest'][2])
check('subnet 17', out['manifest'][4]['target'].startswith('2001:db8:1:1211::'), out['manifest'][4])

# four queries and a request frozen at its own query
rows=[icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
      app('a1',1,25,'home',2,h('1'),'web',0,'closed','')]
req={'id':'c1','at':10,'lease':'home','target':h('1'),'service':'web','group':'all'}
off={'id':'o1','time':30,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','capacity':1,'cost':1,'group':'all','requests':['c1']}
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10,20,30,40],captures=[capture(rows)],requests=[req],offers=[off])
out,_=run(job)
check('four snapshots', [s['at'] for s in out['snapshots']]==[10,20,30,40], out['snapshots'])
check('frozen active', out['active_requests']==[{'id':'c1','active':True}], out['active_requests'])
check('closed later', out['snapshots'][3]['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_closed']==[h('1')],
      out['snapshots'][3]['leases'][0]['services'][0])

# request at a later query stays active even if closed earlier
req2=dict(req); req2['at']=30
job['requests']=[req2]
out,_=run(job)
check('request at later query', out['active_requests']==[{'id':'c1','active':False}], out['active_requests'])

# duplicate request ids are rejected
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],requests=[req,dict(req)])
out,_=run(job)
check('duplicate request id', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# unknown service in a request
req3=dict(req); req3['service']='nope'
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],requests=[req3])
out,_=run(job)
check('unknown service request', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# request at a non query time
req4=dict(req); req4['at']=15
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],requests=[req4])
out,_=run(job)
check('request at unknown query', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# lease end beyond the time range
job=base_job(leases=[lease(start=0,end=10**12+1)],queries=[10])
out,_=run(job)
check('lease end 10^12+1', 'error' not in out, out)
print('failures',globals().get('FAILURES',0))
PYEOF
